business_problem: replace siloed data platforms and duplicated CRM movement with a faster, easier-to-share analytics foundation for energy forecasting, pricing, and business insight.
solution_summary: Vandebron uses Snowflake as a shared analytics foundation to unify energy, customer, and business data across its green-energy operations and the wider Essent ecosystem. Forecasting data, consumption data, pricing information, and CRM-related datasets are brought into Snowflake from previously siloed platforms so analysts, customer agents, and leadership teams can work from the same governed environment. The platform gives Vandebron enough performance to run complex jobs in minutes instead of hours, while worksheets let nontechnical teams self-serve reports and dashboards directly. Snowflake’s multi-cloud support also lets Vandebron share trusted data with associated brands without worrying about underlying cloud differences, reducing duplication and improving consistency across the business.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Acts as the central data engine and governed workspace for energy forecasting, reporting, and ecosystem-wide data sharing.

data_flow: Energy production, consumption, pricing, and CRM-related datasets are centralized in Snowflake, where analysts and business users query the data directly. Curated outputs are then shared to internal teams and associated brands across the wider Essent ecosystem.
business_outcome: Vandebron reduced a job that once took 9 hours to just 2 minutes, enabled 140 users to self-serve through the Data Cloud, and made cross-brand data sharing much easier to operate.
